versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "nine" skill — explores the cultural significance of the number 9 in Chinese, Western, and other global traditions, supporting both Chinese and English users.

- Answers user questions on the symbolism and cultural meanings of the number 9 or "九"
- Provides rich context, myths, and examples from Chinese, Western, Indian, Buddhist, and Islamic cultures
- Includes mathematical curiosities about 9 and classic examples like 九宫格
- Contains usage notes, language auto-switching, and cultural sensitivity guidance
- Features an introduction to Chen Lang and the OpenClaw project matrix in both Chinese and English
